items.title: Police make 33 arrests as part of child sexual abuse inquiry in Southampton
items.summary: One man due to be sentenced in January after pleading guilty to sexually assaulting 17-year-old girl Police investigating claims of widespread sexual abuse of children in Southampton have arrested more than 30 people. One man is due to be sentenced in January after pleading guilty to sexually assaulting a 17-year-old girl, while another man will stand trial next month charged with raping a 15-year-old. items.title: Woman, 21, killed in car crash in Staffordshire after police pursuit
items.summary: Staffordshire police reports itself to police watchdog after Seat Ibiza involved in collision with Vauxhall Astra A 21-year-old woman has been killed after the car she was travelling in crashed following a police pursuit. Staffordshire police said it had reported itself to the police watchdog, the Independent Office for Police Conduct, after the Seat Ibiza was involved in a collision with a Vauxhall Astra. The woman was a front seat passenger in the Seat. Continue reading...
